name: CreateKey

parameters.help_en:
The description of the key.
The description can be 0 to 8,192 characters in length.
parameters.help_zh:
密钥的描述。  
长度为0~8192个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The usage of the key. Valid values:

ENCRYPT/DECRYPT: encrypts and decrypts data.

SIGN/VERIFY: generates and verifies digital signatures.

Default value: If the key supports signature verification, the default value is SIGN/VERIFY. Otherwise, the default value is ENCRYPT/DECRYPT
parameters.help_zh:
密钥的用途。取值：  
ENCRYPT/DECRYPT：数据加密和解密。
SIGN/VERIFY：产生和验证数字签名。

默认值：如果密钥支持签名验签，默认值为SIGN/VERIFY，否则默认值为ENCRYPT/DECRYPT。
parameters.name: key_usage

parameters.help_en:
The source of the key material. Valid values:

Aliyun_KMS (default): The key material is generated by Alibaba Cloud KMS.

EXTERNAL: The key material is imported.

The value is case-sensitive.

If you set this parameter to EXTERNAL, import key material. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607841.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/608827.html
parameters.help_zh:
密钥材料来源。取值：  
Aliyun_KMS（默认值）：密钥材料由阿里云KMS生成。
EXTERNAL：密钥材料由您自行导入。


请注意区分大小写。
如果选择EXTERNAL，您需要自行导入密钥材料。具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607841.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/608827.html
parameters.name: origin

parameters.help_en:
You do not need to specify this parameter. KMS automatically sets an appropriate protection level for your key.

The protection level of the key. Valid values:

SOFTWARE

HSM

If you specify DKMSInstanceId, this parameter is ignored. If the instance is a software key management instance, the protection level is SOFTWARE. If the instance is a hardware key management instance, the protection level is HSM.

If you do not specify DKMSInstanceId, leave this parameter empty. KMS sets the protection level. If a managed HSM is available in the region, KMS sets this parameter to HSM. Otherwise, KMS sets this parameter to SOFTWARE. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/125803.html
parameters.help_zh:
您无需输入本参数，KMS会为您的密钥设置合适的保护级别。

密钥的保护级别，取值：  
SOFTWARE
HSM

如果指定了DKMSInstanceId：本参数输入后不生效。当实例为KMS软件密钥管理实例时，密钥保护级别为SOFTWARE；当实例为KMS硬件密钥管理实例时，密钥保护级别为HSM。
如果未指定DKMSInstanceId：建议您不输入，由KMS设置。当KMS在该地域有托管密码机时，本参数将设置HSM，否则为SOFTWARE。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/125803.html
parameters.name: protection_level

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic key rotation. Valid values:

true: enables automatic key rotation.

false (default): disables automatic key rotation.

This parameter is valid only when the key management type of the key supports automatic rotation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2358146.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启密钥自动轮转。取值：  
true：开启
false（默认值）：不开启

仅当密钥所属的密钥管理类型支持自动轮转时，该参数值有效。具体内容，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2358146.html
parameters.name: enable_automatic_rotation

parameters.help_en:
The automatic rotation period. The format is \`integer\[unit]\`. \`integer\` indicates the length of the period. \`unit\` indicates the unit of time. Valid units: d (day), h (hour), m (minute), and s (second). For example, both 7d and 604800s represent a period of 7 days.

If the key is a default key, the value is 365d.

If the key is a software-protected key, the value can be from 7d to 365d.

If the key is a hardware-protected key, automatic rotation is not supported.

This parameter is required if you set EnableAutomaticRotation to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动轮转的时间周期。格式为integer[unit]，其中integer表示时间长度，unit表示时间单位。合法的unit单位为：d（天）、h（小时）、m（分钟）、s（秒）。7d或者604800s均表示7天的周期。

当密钥为默认密钥时，取值为365天。

当密钥为软件密钥时，取值为7~365天。

当密钥为硬件密钥时，不支持自动轮转。

当EnableAutomaticRotation参数为true时，必须设置此参数
parameters.name: rotation_interval

parameters.help_en:
The specification of the key. The valid values vary based on the key management type. For more information about key specifications, supported standards, and algorithms, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480161.html.

If you do not specify this parameter, the key specification is Aliyun_AES_256 by default
parameters.help_zh:
密钥规格，不同密钥管理类型的取值不同。关于密钥规格、遵循的标准、密钥算法的详细介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480161.html。

不输入参数值时，密钥规格默认为Aliyun_AES_256
parameters.name: key_spec

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the KMS instance.

This parameter is required when you create a key for a KMS instance. This parameter is not required when you create a default key (master key)
parameters.help_zh:
KMS实例的实例ID。

当您需要为KMS实例创建密钥时，必须指定本参数。当您需要创建默认密钥（主密钥）时，不需要指定本参数
parameters.name: dkms_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The tags to bind to the key. Each tag consists of a key-value pair (Key:Value), which includes a tag key and a tag value.

Specify a maximum of 20 tags. To specify multiple tags, use the following format: `[{"TagKey":"key1","TagValue":"value1"},{"TagKey":"key2","TagValue":"value2"},...]`.

Each tag key and tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, forward slashes (/), backslashes (), underscores (_), hyphens (-), periods (.), plus signs (+), equal signs (=), colons (:), and at signs (@).

The tag key cannot start with aliyun or acs:
parameters.help_zh:
为密钥绑定标签。每个标签由一个键值对（Key:Value）组成，包含标签键（Key）、标签值（Value）。

最多输入20个标签。输入多个标签时，格式为`[{"TagKey":"key1","TagValue":"value1"},{"TagKey":"key2","TagValue":"value2"},...]`。

每个标签键（Key）和每个标签值（Value）最多支持128个字符，可以包含英文大小写字母、数字、正斜线（/）、反斜线（\）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）、半角句号（.）、加号（+）、等于号（=）、半角冒号（:）、字符at（@）。
标签键不能以aliyun和acs:开头
parameters.name: tags
policy

parameters.help_en:
The key storage location. This parameter is valid only when DKMSInstanceId is specified for a hardware key management instance. Valid values:

HsmInternal (default): The key is stored in an HSM and does not support rotation.

HsmEncryptedDatabase: The key is stored in a database.

Symmetric keys: Rotation is supported.

Asymmetric keys: Rotation is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
密钥存储位置，仅当DKMSInstanceId输入的是KMS硬件密钥管理实例时生效。取值：
HsmInternal（默认）：密钥存储在密码机中，不支持轮转。
HsmEncryptedDatabase：密钥存储在数据库中。
对称密钥：支持轮转。
非对称密钥：不支持轮转
parameters.name: key_storage_mechanism

Arn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the key

AutomaticRotation.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic key rotation is enabled. Valid values:

Enabled: Automatic rotation is enabled.

Disabled: Automatic rotation is disabled.

Suspended: Automatic rotation is suspended
AutomaticRotation.description_zh:
是否开启了密钥自动轮转，取值：

Enabled：自动轮转处于开启状态。
Disabled：自动轮转处于未开启状态。
Suspended：自动轮转被暂停执行

CreationDate.description_en: The date and time when the key was created. The time is in UTC
CreationDate.description_zh: 密钥创建的日期和时间（UTC）

DKMSInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the KMS instance

DeleteDate.description_en:
The scheduled time to delete the key. For more information, see [ScheduleKeyDeletion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601417.html） .

This parameter is returned only when the value of KeyState is PendingDeletion
DeleteDate.description_zh:
密钥的预计删除时间。 更多信息，请参见[ScheduleKeyDeletion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601417.html）。

仅当KeyState值为PendingDeletion时，才返回该参数

KeyId.description_en: The globally unique identifier (GUID) of the key
KeyId.description_zh: 密钥的全局唯一标识符

KeyState.description_en:
The status of the key.
For more information, see [Impact of CMK status on API calls]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44211.html）.
KeyState.description_zh:
密钥的状态。  
更多信息，请参见[用户主密钥的状态对API调用的影响]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44211.html）

LastRotationDate.description_en:
The time when the last rotation was performed. The time is in UTC.
If the key is new, this value is the generation time of the initial key version.
LastRotationDate.description_zh:
最近一次轮转的时间（UTC）。  
如果是新创建密钥，则为初始密钥版本生成时间

MaterialExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the key material. The time is in UTC.
If this value is empty, the key material does not expire.
MaterialExpireTime.description_zh:
密钥材料的过期时间（UTC）。  
当该值为空时，表示密钥材料不会过期

NextRotationDate.description_en:
The time when the next rotation is scheduled.

This parameter is returned only when the value of AutomaticRotation is Enabled or Suspended
NextRotationDate.description_zh:
密钥下一次轮转的时间。  

仅当AutomaticRotation参数值为Enabled或Suspended时，才返回该值

Origin.description_en: The source of the key material

PrimaryKeyVersion.description_en: The ID of the current primary version of the key
PrimaryKeyVersion.description_zh: 密钥的当前主版本标识符。

ProtectionLevel.description_en: The protection level of the key

RotationInterval.description_en:
The automatic rotation period of the key. The value is in seconds. The value is an integer followed by the character s. For example, a rotation period of 7 days is 604800s.

This parameter is returned only when the value of AutomaticRotation is Enabled or Suspended
RotationInterval.description_zh:
密钥自动轮转的周期。单位为秒，格式为整数值后加上字符s。例如：7天的轮转周期为604800s。

仅当AutomaticRotation参数值为Enabled或Suspended时，才返回该值

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is a globally unique identifier (GUID) generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. Use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
